# About Mailchimp & Co

Mailchimp & Co is a program for agencies and freelancers who manage their clients’ needs. When you join, you’ll gain access to exclusive tools, a community of experts, and more. The higher your membership level, the more tools you’ll have access to.

In this article, you’ll learn how to join and unlock the benefits of Mailchimp & Co.

## Requirements

Mailchimp & Co is free to join whether you’re new to Mailchimp or have an existing account. After you accept the [additional terms and conditions](https://mailchimp.com/legal/), you’ll start the program as a member and unlock new levels when you meet the qualifications.

Here are the levels and qualifications for each.

**Member**

- This is the introductory level and requires only a Mailchimp account.
- After you [**connect at least two customer accounts**](https://mailchimp.com/help/connect-client-accounts/) on paid plans, you’re eligible to [**earn commission**](https://mailchimp.com/help/earn-commission/).

**Partner**

- Connect 10 or more customers on a paid Mailchimp plan.
- Complete the Mailchimp Foundations course in Mailchimp Academy.

**Pro Partner**

- Connect to 20 or more customers on a paid plan.
- Complete the Mailchimp Foundations course in Mailchimp Academy.
- Complete Email Marketing and/or Email Automations certifications in Mailchimp Academy.

## Sign up and get started

Now that you’re familiar with the program, it’s time to sign up and learn what you can do.

To join Mailchimp & Co, follow these steps.

1. Navigate to the [**Mailchimp & Co page.**](https://mailchimp.com/andco/)
2. Click **Join Mailchimp & Co**.
3. If you already have a Mailchimp account, click **Join With An Existing Account** and enter your login credentials.
   ![Cursor Clicks- Join With An Existing Account](https://mailchimp.com/ctf/images/yzco4xsimv0y/2mKVHg5Y8AZIxwKRaNgGte/7de69fbc7e7ddf7ec679c20e842bd671/Cursor_Clicks-_Join_With_An_Existing_Account.png)
    If you don’t have a Mailchimp account yet, click **Create Account** and follow the steps to sign up.

Nice job! A Mailchimp & Co icon will now show in your account. Click on the icon to see what tools you have access to. To learn more, check out [**Getting Started with Mailchimp & Co.**](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-mailchimp-and-co/)

## Leaving Mailchimp & Co

If you ever want to remove yourself from the program, you can do it from your account settings. After you leave, your connected accounts will be disconnected and you will no longer have access to the program tools or benefits.

To leave Mailchimp & Co, follow these steps.

1. Click your profile icon and choose **Account.**
2. Click the **Settings** drop-down and choose **Details.**
3. Scroll to the **Mailchimp & Co** section and click **Remove Mailchimp & Co From My Account.**
   ![Cursor Clicks - Remove Mailchimp & Co From My Account](https://mailchimp.com/ctf/images/yzco4xsimv0y/7coRSDpJIZQXpgb2XGxBNp/abdf727f971f976178582eed9233b0cc/Cursor_Clicks_-_Remove_Mailchimp___Co_From_My_Account.png)
4. In the **Are you sure?** modal, click **Yes, I’m Sure** to confirm. This action cannot be undone.
   ![Cursor Clicks - Yes Im Sure - Mailchimp & Co Disconnect](https://mailchimp.com/ctf/images/yzco4xsimv0y/2D7FZdex7kgjdC5BnGhwvs/aa66a4095c1b969889cc37e8c0aaf237/Cursor_Clicks_-_Yes_Im_Sure_-_Mailchimp___Co_Disconnect.png)

**Note**

If you leave Mailchimp & Co and later decide to sign up again, you may be required to join at a lower membership level.
